g1.flow: The same promise twice in a row. The first opens fa-inna ('For indeed'): its fa ties it to the ayah before, 'raised high for you your repute'. The second repeats it plain, inna, with nothing in front. Hook: fa comes first, then it drops off on the echo. After the plain inna, the surah turns to 'So when you have finished'.

cues.94:5: Fa-inna: straight after 'raised high for you your repute'.
cues.94:6: Plain inna: right after the fa-inna line; next, 'So when you have finished'.
